name: @devos/api
description: DevOS API (M1.2): NestJS, Tailscale identity, 12-hour session, CSRF, security headers, request-ID JSON logs, OpenAPI contract.

scripts.test: pnpm --filter @devos/policy --filter @devos/analyst --filter @devos/isolation --filter @devos/run-engine run build && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --test "test/*.test.mjs"
scripts.test:db: pnpm --filter @devos/policy --filter @devos/analyst --filter @devos/isolation run build && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --test --test-concurrency=1 "test-db/*.test.mjs"
